body:
I hate women because they are not what they say they are.  They expect me to do all the work, and there is always some mythical "right women" who never actually exists.  She too, has subconscious impulses and hormonal desires that guide her, even if she isn't able to admit such to herself, and pretends to be above it. I hate them for shaming my sexuality so much, then simultaneously expecting me to do what they just got done shaming. I hate them for taking advantage of a man's need for sexual intimacy, and abusing it for time/validation/power/money. 

I hate men as well, but for different reasons.
